### [Interactive solar and shading study](https://jinggling09.github.io/solar-studie.html)
An AI-assisted energy-renovation learning project: explore solar position, arrange PV modules on provisional roof surfaces, estimate daily, monthly and quarterly generation, and compare battery capacities. The public demo uses a fictional reference location and example consumption. Building shadows are visualized but are not automatically deducted from energy estimates.

[View demo](https://jinggling09.github.io/solar-studie.html) · Updated: 2 November 2026 · German calculators, partly English 3D controls
:::

::: {.karte}
### [Germany climate dashboard](../wissen/emissionen-de.qmd)
Interactive analysis of the national GHG inventories of the German Environment Agency: total emissions against the Climate Protection Act target path, sector trends and sector shares. Updated automatically from the UBA DataCube.

[Live]{.status} · [Code](https://github.com/jinggling09/germany-climate-dashboard)
:::
